about: Rover settings definition, owned by Trail_Tracer_Mower (docs/settings_def.json). The PC uses an unchanged copy. Words from the PC draft (Trail-Tracer-PC-Telemetry 22deeea); values checked against src/usb_msc_fat.cpp (defaults, limits) and src/main.cpp (STATIONARY_KEYS). Format: Trail-Tracer-PC-Telemetry docs/control_api.md, section 3. 'list' ends 'end <n> def 6'. Version 6: groups in user order ('groups'), a 'label' per setting, DSP settings (dsp_*) with read-only values in effect (dsp_*_eff, 'readonly': true; 'effect' names the _eff key of a setting).

groups.name: Vehicle
groups.description: Vehicle number, battery and the motion sensor

groups.name: Wire and sensors
groups.description: Which wire signal the vehicle follows, and with which sensors

groups.name: Speed
groups.description: Throttle for wire following and for the slow approach

groups.name: Steering
groups.description: How hard the vehicle steers back to the wire

groups.name: Beacons
groups.description: Beacon detection and the slow approach after a beacon

groups.name: Stuck detection
groups.description: When the vehicle counts as stuck

groups.name: Swerve
groups.description: Side-to-side swerve while the vehicle follows the wire

groups.name: Rover mode
groups.description: The autopilot: bounce inside the wire loop, go home to charge

groups.name: Radio and log
groups.description: Radio link, telemetry and the on-board log

groups.name: Signal processing
groups.description: Sensor board: update period, sensors and frequency slots

groups.name: Signal processing: advanced
groups.description: Sensor board details; change them only for a test

groups.name: Servo outputs
groups.description: Pulse limits of the four servo outputs

battery_cells.description: Battery cells in series (2 for a 2S battery); the power graph scales from it
battery_cells.label: Battery cells

imu_required.description: No effect since firmware 0.5.40: with no working IMU, the gyro lock keeps the motors off (the main branch f10cd31). Kept for old config files
imu_required.label: Motion sensor required

usb_drive.label: USB drive for config.json
usb_drive.description: true (default): the rover shows config.json as a USB drive on the PC. false: no USB drive; change settings by command or in the telemetry program. Takes effect at the next start.

rx_channel.description: Transmitter channel that the Rx listens to
rx_channel.label: Wire channel

enable_sensor_2.description: Use sensor 2 (it always listens on transmitter channel 1)
enable_sensor_2.label: Use sensor 2

CRUISE_THROTTLE.description: Throttle pulse when the vehicle follows the wire
CRUISE_THROTTLE.label: Cruise throttle

CREEP_THROTTLE.description: Throttle pulse for the slow approach
CREEP_THROTTLE.label: Slow throttle

kp.description: Proportional part of the steering PID
kp.label: Steering gain (P)

ki.description: Integral part of the steering PID
ki.label: Steering gain (I)

kd.description: Derivative part of the steering PID
kd.label: Steering gain (D)

steering_rate_kp.description: Proportional part of the yaw-rate steering PID (gyro feedback; output -1..1)
steering_rate_kp.label: Gyro steering gain (P)

steering_rate_ki.description: Integral part of the yaw-rate steering PID
steering_rate_ki.label: Gyro steering gain (I)

steering_rate_kd.description: Derivative part of the yaw-rate steering PID
steering_rate_kd.label: Gyro steering gain (D)

steering_rate_pid_direction.description: Yaw-rate PID direction: true reverses it
steering_rate_pid_direction.label: Reverse gyro steering

steering_rate_max_dps.description: Yaw rate in deg/s at full steering command
steering_rate_max_dps.label: Turn rate at full steer

BTxCreepDuration.description: Time of the slow approach after a beacon
BTxCreepDuration.label: Slow approach time

stuck_threshold_mm.description: Smallest movement that counts as not stuck
stuck_threshold_mm.label: Stuck: smallest movement

stuck_timeout_ms.description: Time below that movement before the vehicle is stuck
stuck_timeout_ms.label: Stuck: time

SineSwerveAmplitude.description: Swerve size to each side (0 = off)
SineSwerveAmplitude.label: Swerve size

CHARGE_VBATT_STOP.description: End the charge at this battery voltage. STM32 limit 16.0 V
CHARGE_VBATT_STOP.label: Charge end voltage

CHARGE_MAX_CURRENT.description: Stop the charge above this current, then wait 10 s. STM32 limit 6.0 A
CHARGE_MAX_CURRENT.label: Charge current limit

CHARGE_MAX_SECONDS.description: Half the longest charge: the STM32 stops a charge after 2 x this value (at most 3600 s)
CHARGE_MAX_SECONDS.label: Charge time limit (half)

rover_enabled.description: In autonomous drive mode, the autopilot drives, not the wire follower
rover_enabled.label: Rover mode on

rover_goal_cw.description: Direction along the wire into the charger: true = clockwise seen from above
rover_goal_cw.label: Charger direction clockwise

rover_sensor_height_mm.description: Distance of the sensor centre above the wire
rover_sensor_height_mm.label: Sensor height

rover_full_speed_mps.description: Ground speed at full drive command (measure it)
rover_full_speed_mps.label: Speed at full drive

rover_full_yaw_rate_dps.description: Not used from firmware 0.5.61: the autopilot takes steering_rate_max_dps, the full scale of the gyro rate loop. Kept so that older config files load
rover_full_yaw_rate_dps.label: Turn rate at full steer (rover)

rover_seek_vbatt.description: Go to the charger below this battery voltage (0 = off, else 6 to 26)
rover_seek_vbatt.label: Go home below this voltage

rover_seek_after_s.description: Go to the charger this long after the last charge (0 = off)
rover_seek_after_s.label: Go home after this time

rover_entry_btx.description: Beacon channel before the charger: slow approach (0 = none)
rover_entry_btx.label: Beacon before the charger

rover_exit_btx.description: Beacon channel after the charger exit: the vehicle turns back if it meets this beacon first (0 = none)
rover_exit_btx.label: Beacon after the charger

rover_lost_timeout_s.description: The autopilot halts after this long without the wire (0 = never)
rover_lost_timeout_s.label: Stop after wire lost for

rover_speed_limit_mps.description: Highest autopilot speed (0 = the simulator speeds)
rover_speed_limit_mps.label: Rover speed limit

espnow_enabled.description: Telemetry messages over ESP-NOW. If telemetry_enabled is also false, the vehicle takes no commands. The vehicle refuses false over ESP-NOW
espnow_enabled.label: Radio messages

telemetry_rate_hz.description: Vehicle log sample rate in Hz. Below 100 Hz an anti-alias filter (two moving averages) runs first. Other values go to the nearest allowed rate
telemetry_rate_hz.label: Log rate

telemetry_bins_hz.description: Rate in Hz of the coil magnitudes of all 8 frequency bins in the vehicle log, for the per-bin plots. The same anti-alias filter as the log rate runs first. 0 = off
telemetry_bins_hz.label: Coil plot rate

espnow_tx_power_dbm.description: Radio transmit power in dBm, 0.25 dB steps. 19.5 is the radio's maximum. A low power over the radio can lose the link to this vehicle
espnow_tx_power_dbm.label: Radio power

telemetry_enabled.description: Vehicle log over ESP-NOW. If espnow_enabled is also false, the vehicle takes no commands. The vehicle refuses false over ESP-NOW
telemetry_enabled.label: Telemetry

cmd_key.description: Fleet password; 0 = blank (accepts key 0); USB or config.json only
cmd_key.label: Fleet password

dsp_frame_period_us.label: Update period
dsp_frame_period_us.description: Time between two position updates from the sensor board. A longer period averages more signal: less noise, slower response. The board uses the nearest period that it can make. Default 10000 us (10 ms); the shortest setting is 3600 us.

dsp_frame_period_us_eff.label: Update period (in effect)
dsp_frame_period_us_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_sensors.label: Sensors on the board
dsp_sensors.description: Number of wire sensors that the sensor board reads: 1 or 2. With 1 sensor, the board reads it faster.

dsp_sensors_eff.label: Sensors on the board (in effect)
dsp_sensors_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_0.label: Frequency slot 1
dsp_bin_hz_0.description: Frequency that slot 1 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: transmitter channel 1 (53333.3 Hz). Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_0_eff.label: Frequency slot 1 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_0_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_1.label: Frequency slot 2
dsp_bin_hz_1.description: Frequency that slot 2 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: transmitter channel 2 (55315.5 Hz). Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_1_eff.label: Frequency slot 2 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_1_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_2.label: Frequency slot 3
dsp_bin_hz_2.description: Frequency that slot 3 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: transmitter channel 3 (51323.2 Hz). Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_2_eff.label: Frequency slot 3 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_2_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_3.label: Frequency slot 4
dsp_bin_hz_3.description: Frequency that slot 4 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: transmitter channel 4 (57347.7 Hz). Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_3_eff.label: Frequency slot 4 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_3_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_4.label: Frequency slot 5
dsp_bin_hz_4.description: Frequency that slot 5 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: transmitter channel 5 (49344.6 Hz). Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_4_eff.label: Frequency slot 5 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_4_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_5.label: Frequency slot 6
dsp_bin_hz_5.description: Frequency that slot 6 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: 62500 Hz. Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_5_eff.label: Frequency slot 6 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_5_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_6.label: Frequency slot 7
dsp_bin_hz_6.description: Frequency that slot 7 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: 46875 Hz. Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_6_eff.label: Frequency slot 7 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_6_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_bin_hz_7.label: Frequency slot 8
dsp_bin_hz_7.description: Frequency that slot 8 listens to, in Hz; 0 = slot off. Default: off. Slots 1-5 are the transmitter channels 1-5.

dsp_bin_hz_7_eff.label: Frequency slot 8 (in effect)
dsp_bin_hz_7_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_slow_adc.label: Battery and charge measurement
dsp_slow_adc.description: 1 = on (default). 0 = off: the board does not charge and does not measure the battery; the sensors get the time.

dsp_slow_adc_eff.label: Battery and charge measurement (in effect)
dsp_slow_adc_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_pga.label: Input gain
dsp_pga.description: -1 = automatic (default). 0, 1, 2 = a fixed gain step for both sensors.

dsp_pga_eff.label: Input gain (in effect)
dsp_pga_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_lanes.label: Sensor lanes
dsp_lanes.description: Which sensor feeds which data lane: 2 (default) = lane 1 sensor 1, lane 2 sensor 2. With 1 sensor, bit 0 selects the sensor.

dsp_lanes_eff.label: Sensor lanes (in effect)
dsp_lanes_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.

dsp_xy_mask.label: Position slots (bit mask)
dsp_xy_mask.description: Slots that give x/y positions in place of signal strengths: bit 0 = slot 1, bit 1 = slot 2, ... bit 7 = slot 8. 0 (default) = none.

dsp_xy_mask_eff.label: Position slots (bit mask) (in effect)
dsp_xy_mask_eff.description: The value that the sensor board uses now (its answer). Empty until the board answers; it can differ from the setting when the board rounds or limits it.
